QUOTE: The text before the first `:` is the tool glob. The text after it is an argument glob. ... Matching is plain `fnmatch` with flags 0. ... `filesystem.*` (no `:`) | the fully-qualified tool name matches the fnmatch glob, whatever the args
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, splitting at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a pattern without a colon matches on the tool name alone.
